neighbours.label: a pronoun addressing the reader or including them ('you', 'your', 'we') in a general claim about life or the body
fire: Your lungs work all day, and while you may not feel it, your breathing slows at night.
Your skin is your largest organ, since your health depends on it in many ways.
Your eyes get tired, and although you rarely notice it, your focus drifts by evening.
Your bones keep changing, and even when you are resting, your body builds new ones.
Every time you eat, your brain gets a signal, because your gut talks to it.
Microbes live all over us, and we are learning that we need them to stay well.
Your heart beats without effort, so you can forget that your life depends on it.
The food that we eat shapes the cities we live in and the air we breathe.
quiet: Her lungs work all day, and while she may not feel it, her breathing slows at night.
His skin is his largest organ, since his health depends on it in many ways.
Her eyes get tired, and although she rarely notices it, her focus drifts by evening.
His bones keep changing, and even when he is resting, his body builds new ones.
Every time a dog eats, its brain gets a signal, because its gut talks to it.
Microbes live all over them, and they are learning that they need them to stay well.
His heart beats without effort, so he can forget that his life depends on it.
The food that farmers grow shapes the towns they live in and the air they breathe.

notes: Card: ' you' x10, ' You' x4, ' your' x3, ' we' x3, and 你. Probe: 'while you might not notice' 0.195; 你 0.189; 'that we occupy and use' 0.157; 'Do you know that you' 0.078; third person version 0.008. Low activations; the median may not reach the line.
